module_summary: FIFO controller computing fill level from head/tail pointers and responding to inc/dec commands.

anchors.name: head
anchors.why: Read pointer; increments on dec command, cleared on clr.

anchors.name: tail
anchors.why: Write pointer; increments on inc command, cleared on clr.

anchors.name: fill
anchors.why: Occupancy counter; computed from head/tail via delta and updated.

anchors.name: inc
anchors.why: Increment command; advances tail pointer and increments fill.

anchors.name: dec
anchors.why: Decrement command; advances head pointer and decrements fill.

anchors.name: delta
anchors.why: Fill change; computed from inc/dec to update occupancy.

groups.name: Pointer Management
groups.description: Read and write pointers for circular FIFO indexing.

groups.name: Control Inputs
groups.description: Inc/dec commands steering pointer and fill updates.
